rules:
The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$m$$$ $$$(1 \le n, m \le 2 \cdot 10^{5})$$$ — the number of dormitories and the number of letters.

The second line contains a sequence $$$a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$$$ $$$(1 \le a_i \le 10^{10})$$$, where $$$a_i$$$ equals to the number of rooms in the $$$i$$$-th dormitory. The third line contains a sequence $$$b_1, b_2, \dots, b_m$$$ $$$(1 \le b_j \le a_1 + a_2 + \dots + a_n)$$$, where $$$b_j$$$ equals to the room number (among all rooms of all dormitories) for the $$$j$$$-th letter. All $$$b_j$$$ are given in increasing order. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
